༄༅/ /grub mchog dril bu lugs kyi bde mchog rim lnga'i rdzogs rim gyi dmigs skor tshang ba'i gsol 'debs dngos grub mchog stsol bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// grub mchog dril bu lugs kyi bde mchog rim lnga'i rdzogs rim gyi dmigs skor tshang ba'i gsol 'debs dngos grub mchog stsol bzhugs so//

na mo gu ru rat+na shrī tsakra sam+ba rā ya/ dpal rigs kun bdag po rdo rje 'chang*// sku gcig la dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi| |zhing 'khor dang bcas pa'i bkod pa rdzogs// rje mtshungs med rin chen dpal la 'dud// dpyid bde ba chen po'i ngang nyid du// yongs shes bya'i 'khor lo kun sdom pa// lha he ru ka dpal yab yum dang*// don gnyis med bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// bdag legs tshogs kun gyi rtsa ba ni| |pha bla ma rje la rag las pas// dus 'di nas byang chub snying po'i bar// skyid sdug gi khag de bla mas mkhyen// yul cir snang bla ma'i sku ru bsgom// sgrar gang grag rje btsun gsung du 'dzer// sems dran rtog bde stong gcig tu 'dres// lam gcig chog rgyal po 'di la re// rje bka' drin mnyam med 'bri gung pas// yongs mdo rgyud gdams par ngo sprad pa'i// bstan 'di dang mjal ba'i skal bzang ni// dus da res tsam zhig yin na yang*// dbugs na bun lta bur yal la nye// srog ba thag tsam de chad la khad// dgra 'chi bdag gshed mas gsod nges pas// da lha chos snying po len par gces// sngon sgo gsum sdig la spyad spyad pas// brnag dka' ba ngan song sdug bsngal de// bdag lus sems gnyis kyi thog tu 'bab// nyam chung gis bzod glags mi gda' bas// sprang 'khos med re ltos bla ma lha// skyabs dkon mchog gsum la snying nas zhu// rgyu dkar nag las kyi blang dor la// da bag yod 'bad pa 'dun ma'i rtse// dug bdud rtsir 'khrul ba'i btung ba bzhin// yul 'dod yon sred zhen phung gi rgyu// mdang rmi lam dga' ba'i rol rtsed dang*// dpal lha mi'i phun tshogs bslu ba mtshungs// khams gsum gyi gnas lugs gang la yang*// blo thub pa'i bde ba cang ma mchis// sdug sna dgu 'dzoms pa'i btson ra la// zhe blo bder sdod pa shin tu 'khrul// sems cang shes kha lo gyen du bsgyur// chos bslab pa gsum gyi srab kyis bcings// 'bad brtson pa drag po'i lcag bzhus nas// da thar pa'i lam la dkyus thog gcod// bdag drin gyis bskyangs pa'i ma rgan rnams// gnas 'jigs rung 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor lhungs// sdug nyam thag ngang tshul ma bsam na// bu don snying gting nas rul bas na| |rang skyid 'dod blo sna lings kyis bor/

/gzhan phan bde'i thabs dgu snying dbus bcang*/ /dpal don gnyis mthar phyin sangs rgyas de// thabs phyin drug spyod pas sgrub la 'bad// sems cha cho'i 'gyu ba rbad kyis bcad// rten dmigs pa gcig la dran pas bzung*// bgegs bying rgod dbang du ma shor bar// sgom bde gsal ngang la shes pa bcun// chos can gyi snang tshul mtha' yas 'di// blo 'khrul pas bzhag pa bslu ba can// don sdod lugs snying po btsal ba na// dmigs gtad so bral ba'i stong par 'char| |yul gang shar rang tshugs zhig pas na// ming rkyang pa tsam zhig shul du lus// don 'di la gzhan ngor rten 'brel zhes// chos kun gyi 'jog sa de ga tsam// dpal 'phags pa yab sras bzhed pa'i srol// yab 'jig rten mgon pos gtan la phab// mtha' bral gyi lta ba ngo mtshar can// lam thun mong de dag sngon sbyangs te// zhing 'og min gtso bo rdo rje 'chang*| |'dir mi yi gzugs can sprul pa'i sku// gnas rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen por bcug /rgyud smin byed dbang bzhi legs bskur nas// lus ma bcos rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor che| |nyams bag phebs dga' ba'i gzhal med na// dpyid thig le kha sbyor don gyi lha// dpal khrag 'thung gtso bo yab yum dang*// nang rtsa khams dpa' bo ḍā ki'i tshogs// dbyings bde ba chen po'i rol rtsed kyis// rgyud tha mal snang zhen kun bcad nas// yongs gang shar dag pa'i 'khor lor bsgyur// rang gsal stong bde mchog yab yum gyi// lus stong ra bsgom pa'i nang gi gzhung*// rtsa khyad chos sum ldan dhū ti yi// snying chos kyi 'khor lo 'dab brgyad dbus// thabs shes rab nyi zla kha sbyor nang*// gzhom med kyi thig le hūm̐ gi gzugs| |sems brtan pas kun rtog rgyu ba bcad// ston mkha' ltar dag pa'i 'od gsal 'char// yum nang gi phag mo tsaṇ+ḍa līs// rtsa stong phrag don gnyis kun+da'i khams// dpyid dhū tir zhu ba dbab ldog gis// sgras brjod du mi nus dga' bzhi ster// phyi dbang po'i rlung sems 'gro 'ong bral// nang tha mal gti mug mun pa sangs// lam 'od gsal chos sku'i ngo bo dang*| |gnyid dbyer med rnal 'byor nyer bskyangs nas// spyir 'khrul snang kun la rang ngo shes// sgos bag chags lus kyi rmi lam de// lha mtshan dpe'i gar mkhan skur bzhengs nas| |gang 'tsham gyi sprul pa ci yang 'dzin// snying dwangs ma lnga 'dus thig le las// rlung 'jug gnas ldang ba rdo rje gsum// rang chas kyi gsang sngags bzlas pa yis// dbye dka' ba ma rig mdud pa grol// gzhi pad+mar rab gnas rdo rje'i rtse// gnad dbu mar chud pa'i rang sems hūm̐// bcud bdud rtsi'i dwangs ma 'thung 'thung bas// g.yo med kyi lhan cig skyes dgas myos// gnas dbang po'i sgo dang 'khor lo bzhir// ches phra ba'i rdo rje sa bon la// sems brtan pas 'jig rten gsum snang ba'i// phyi yul lnga mtha' dag mngon sum mthong*// yongs mngon shes drug gi skar khung bye// lha bgrang yas rnam 'gyur ltad mo mthong*// gsung rab kyi tshig don kun la dbang*// 'chi med kyi dga' mar rtsed 'jo thob// yar smin dbus gnyis spangs rdo rje'i rtser// 'od nyi zla skar gsum thig ler 'khyil// rten de la rlung sems bcug pa'i mthus// sman ga pur thigs pa mdzad med 'phel| |yid ting 'dzin pir gyis mdzes pa kun// phyogs gcig tu bris pa'i smin legs dang*// rigs mtshan ldan pho nya mor 'grogs pas// rang ci 'dod dga' bde ches cher 'bar| |sngar 'dris kyi bde chen phyag rgyar bcas// de dran pa yis kyang lhan skyes 'char// yid kun khyab chos nyid mdzes ma la// rol rol pas lhan skyes ngang du zhu// 'og sum mdo bde skyong 'khor lo'i dbus// mdangs dkar dmar chos 'byung 'od du 'tsher// dbus thig le sna lnga'i tshom bu la// sems bde gshegs rigs lnga'i ngo bor bltas// rlung dkar ser bum pa lta bu'i dbyibs// gnas de ru bcings pas tshangs pa'i me// a haṃ gi 'bar 'dzag cher g.yos te// lam sngon med bde stong bgrod pa rdzogs// 'od glog gi lcags kyu phyogs brgyar spros// mkha' khyab kyi bde gshegs byin rlabs bkug

/sems rigs lnga'i yi ge slar gsos nas// nyams gong 'phel bdud rtsi'i gru char phab// snod bcud kyi spros pa 'od du yal| |kun rtog gi rba rlabs nye bar zhi// 'od gsal gyi dwangs cha ma 'gag pas// dus mnyam rjes kun la rgya yis thebs// dpe lhan skyes phyag rgya chen po'i dbyings// snang stong gi ri mo 'ja' ltar bkra// thabs bla med sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar// rten brten pa rdzogs pa'i 'khor lor bzhengs// steng mkha' la sprin tshogs dengs pa bzhin// lus sgyu ma 'od gsal ngang du thim// don lhan cig skyes dngos ye shes mes// gdon dngos 'dzin sa bon bcas pa bsregs// dpal rdo rje lta bu'i gzugs sku dang*// sems 'od gsal chen po zung 'jug pa/ */ming dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting 'dzin zhes// mchog bsam mi khyab pa'i rim pa las// dbyings rig pa rang gsal yid bzhin nor// phyi glo bur dri ma kun nas dag |gzhan snang ngor longs sku he ru kaḥ /ci 'dod kyi sprul pas brtan g.yo khyab// yun mi ring snyigs dus tshe thung la// thabs dka' ba med par 'dod don kun// nang bde chen grogs su spyod bzhin du// mchog sangs rgyas de ltar ster ba'i lam// rje sngon byon grub dbang mtha' dag gi// bshul gsang mtha'i rgyud don ma nor bar// tshe 'di la thos bsam sgom gsum gyis// don bde blag nyid du 'grub gyur cig /mchog tshe 'dir ma grub 'chi ba'i tshe// mgon dpa' bo dpa' mo'i bsu ba yi// 'ja' 'od lnga'i gur dbus mchod sprin bcas// gnas mkha' spyod zhing bzang 'khrid par shog /rten rig pa 'dzin pa de nyid la// lam lhag ma'i bgrod pa mthar phyin cing*// dus nam yang rgyal ba'i mdo sngags kyi// chos tshul bzhin 'dzin pa nyid gyur cig /gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i pho brang na// mthu ldan gyi dpa' bo dpa' mo rnams// ma bu gcig brtse bzhin bdag cag la// dus rtag tu g.yel med skyong gyur cig */

ces pa'ang bstan pa'i gsal byed du gyur pa'i dam pa chen po mdo sngags yongs la mkhyen dpyod gzhan dring mi 'jog pa mdo khams lho'i mchog sprul dkon mchog lhun gyis grub pa phrin las rnam par rgyal ba nas/ lam rim gnyis kyi gnad 'gag yongs su rdzogs shing*/ khyad par grub mchog dril bu pa'i lugs kyi bde mchog rim lnga'i rdzogs rim gyi dmigs skor cha tshang ba tshigs bcad go sla 'khyer bde zhig nyams bzhed gsol 'debs su dgos zhes bskul ma mdzad pa ltar/ 'bri gung pa shākya'i dge slong dharma kīrtis sbyar ba dza yan+tu// //shu bhaṃ//
